name: Cultist: Teachings of Mythrax cannot extend the permanent Presence buffs (#1054)
contract: Presence of N'Zoth (803037) and Presence of Y'Shaarj (803035) both use SpellDuration.dbc row 21 (Duration -1, permanent). Aura::CalcMaxDuration (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuras.cpp) only calls Player::ApplySpellMod for SPELLMOD_DURATION when the calculated duration is not -1, and Player::IsAffectedBySpellmod (src/server/game/Entities/Player/Player.cpp) separately refuses any SPELLMOD_DURATION modifier on a spell whose GetDuration() is -1. Teachings of Mythrax (561035) is a SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER / SPELLMOD_DURATION passive, so neither engine guard lets it change these auras regardless of classmask routing: both remain reported as permanent (-1) after learning it. See the report for why implementing the tooltip's literal mechanic is a maintainer decision, not a code fix. Both Presence spells share Category 1079 with StartRecoveryTime 1500 ms (Spell.dbc), so the second cast needs at least that much elapsed time since the first, not the 500 ms this scenario originally waited (which drew SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY, reason 67, on the real server).

steps.label: Presence of N'Zoth's native permanent duration is untouched by Teachings of Mythrax
Presence of Y'Shaarj's native permanent duration is likewise untouched
